title: Seizure
scenario: Person shaking or convulsing all over, eyes rolled back, unresponsive, jerking movements.
steps: Stay calm and time the seizure from the moment it starts.
Clear hard or sharp objects away and cushion their head with something soft.
Loosen anything tight around the neck.
Do not restrain them; let the seizure run its course.
When the shaking stops, roll them onto their side into the recovery position and stay with them while they recover.
Call 911 if the seizure lasts more than 5 minutes, repeats, happens in water, the person is pregnant or injured, has never had a seizure before, or does not wake up afterward.
do_not: Never put anything in a seizing person's mouth.
Do not offer food or drink until fully alert.
